What are the benefits of using Slang AI?

Restaurants using Slang AI report 50% more phone reservations, 96% guest satisfaction, up to 200 hours saved monthly and 10x ROI. Slang AI assistant ensures that calls are answered promptly, reducing missed opportunities and enhancing customer experience.
What is the setup process and duration?
Setting up Slang AI typically requires less than 30 minutes. The onboarding process is streamlined, allowing restaurants to go live on the same day.
Can I customize Slang AI's voice and responses?
Yes, Slang AI offers a selection of premium voices, including various accents, to match your brand's tone. You can also customize greetings and responses to align with your restaurant's style.
How many calls can Slang AI handle at once?
Slang AI can handle an unlimited amount of calls, ensuring that no customer is left waiting, even during peak hours.
Does Slang AI integrate with reservation platforms?
Yes. Slang AI integrates with platforms like OpenTable, allowing seamless reservation management.
What insights does Slang AI provide?

The platform offers analytics on call volume, answer rate, reservations, covers, peak call times, common customer inquiries, and guest satisfaction, among others, helping restaurants make informed operational decisions
Can I keep my existing phone number?

While Slang AI provides a new phone number for use on your website and business profiles, it's possible to keep your existing number. This option should be discussed with the onboarding team during setup.
Is the voice AI conversational and does it sound natural?

Our Voice AI is built by Conversational AI experts who have analyzed hundreds of thousands of call transcripts to inform changes to the way our Voice AI handles real guest questions. They thoroughly consider the key aspects of what makes conversations human – such as latency, prosody, timbre, and fluency to ensure conversations flow naturally.
What happens if Slang AI can't answer a caller's question or someone wants to speak to an actual person?
If Slang AI cannot address a query, it automatically forwards the call to a human staff member or sends a text message with contact information, ensuring the caller receives assistance.
